name: gemini-review
description: Gemini reviews each git commit the model runs, with the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a serious bug, a security hole or a committed secret. /gemini-review turns it on or off; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level. Needs function hooks (early access).

maxInputChars.title: Maximum characters of conversation sent to Gemini
maxInputChars.description: Above it the longest tool outputs of the conversation are cut to their head and tail before sending. The diff is always sent whole.
